resources.string: Magnify a live camera preview and optionally export a frozen frame.
Permission response received. Tap Start again if camera access is allowed.

Uses the back camera and hardware-supported zoom/torch. Freeze captures only a bounded preview, not a full-resolution photo. Quality depends on camera, focus and lighting; this is not an optical measurement.

Explicit Start is required. Backgrounding or leaving stops the camera, turns off torch and clears the frozen frame. No History, Workbench, network or automatic saving. One reviewed frame may remain temporarily in memory while choosing an export destination.

Save this exact frozen preview as a new PNG document? The chosen provider receives its pixels without source metadata. Cancel to keep it unsaved. A failed or interrupted write may leave an empty or partial document.
Export could not complete. The selected provider may have created an empty or partial document; inspect it manually. Nothing was silently deleted.
Start explicitly, grant camera access if needed and tap Start again. Adjust supported zoom or torch, freeze a preview, then optionally review and export a PNG copy.
Point at non-private printed text, adjust zoom, then Freeze and Resume.
Camera-dependent preview quality, not full-resolution photography or measurement. Frozen images are transient except an explicit new-copy export.
